tool: Ghidra 12.1.2; existing RE-VM project; read-only analysis
method: Pseudo-disassembly under the retained NDS32 BE-instruction/LE-data premise. Offset searches produce candidates, not a complete data-flow/writer audit. Selected 400-node direct graph skips 22 callees under assumed return.

ordinary_completion.behavior: Copies the mode-zero scan-context counter into the ordinary completion payload and clears the context counter. The selected start branch also clears that field.

writer.behavior: The selected routine reads frame-control through its input packet context, tests beacon and probe-response subtype values, and increments the same mode-zero counter on applicable branches. Probe-response paths can increment twice; this is not an exact unique-beacon count.

public_source.source_version_gate: Host debug output interprets the counter when scan-done version exceeds 2.

limitations: Positive means execution of an applicable firmware management-processing path; it does not measure RF dwell, identify a peer, count unique beacons, establish frame validity or prove host delivery.
Zero leaves tuning, radio reception, filtering and the counter path itself unresolved.
Not all writers, callback effects or firmware runtime paths have been audited.
No new Gemian scan was issued. A bounded read of existing Gemian scan-completion debug lines returned none; that is not a zero counter.
